content: Gumak danab ag ele ahilag Naḏi, Nug hab aṯan daaṯe ele amu, ag Nug waap̱a daaṯeb amunu ag amu dab menana, ag begbeg ahilḵad dilagp̱a kobol ena tutuḵuib heig!
G̱AGAṮAG UNUQIṮAK KOBOL AMU TUTUḴU OIYAK KOBOL ELE
Amu ag oh ag Kolosi daaṯeb amu, ag unuqiṯak kobol g̱agaṯag aḏan unuqidnana, dab mena autna aonna, Kayak amegp̱a, “Ena hen meḵame,” ele aon aig!
Ag ihinignu ele, ig Kayaknu dab mak Kristusnu, tatam loḵumak dayom, ig nai amu mehuqḵunignu amu ag Kayak Nug ib babaiṯa megaḵunu unuqiṯeg! Da nai amu mehuqmi amunu da mani guiṯakp̱a daaṯem.
Da Kristusnu nai miagib mehuqḵulnu amu ag amunu ele unuqiṯeg! Aḏinu? Kayak Nug uḏat amu da heḵulnu meḏom.
Danab ag nai enanu oolagp̱a genab ii dooṯeb ele, ag Kolosi danab ag danab amu oolagp̱a oinna, ag aḵa ahilag oiyaknu dab mena autna aonna, uḏat heig! Ag haen ahilag hamu aib kakidp̱ig.
Ahilag nai maṯiak amu hanhan enanag amu doyaknu iṯag ele maṯieg! Ag danab oh dilag oḏ mak oolagp̱a daaṯe amu ag nob meḵulagnu elele dab menan dayeg!
PAULUS KOLOSI TAMANIAK DILAG HUMIṮAK NAI ME UḴOM
Ig lainignab Tikikas, nug geha da uḏat heṯem ele imu ohnu maṯieb, ag dooglag. Nug am ig ele uḏat laip̱u, nug Naḏinu uḏat nid enanag.
Nug uḵa, ag amelagp̱a ab, ag ig aṯem daaṯem dooglagnu, nug ag oolag g̱agaṯag qedaḵunu ele, diig aḏit amunu amu da mei goṯe.

Amu da hei, Onisimas Tikikas ele oh goṯep. Onisimas nug ele am ig lainignab, nug ele am Naḏinu uḏat nid ena amu nug am ag ele ab laip̱up̱anu. Danab aḏit amu a geha aḏi keeke oh ip̱a ihinignu beṯe ele amu, a amunu maṯiglah.
Aristakus, nug da ele oh mani guiṯakp̱a daaṯep amu Makus ele a ag humadṯep. Makus, nug Banabas ele a tiilah laip̱u amu, ag nuhignu maṯiak aop̱ig, nug ag gumaṯa uḵeb amu ag nug aweg!
Josua, onig laa Jastas, nug ele ag humadṯe. Juda danab oolagp̱anu danab ewam amu aaḵuib ag Rom ip̱a da ele Kayaknu ḏo maḏoḏnu uḏat laip̱u heṯem. Ahilagp̱a da oo maḏoḏ ele dayak aoṯem.

Epapras, ahilag nid laa, Kristus Jesusnu uḏat danab, nug ele ag humadṯe. Haen oh nug nuhig unuqiṯak g̱agaṯagp̱a nug ag ehanaṯaṯa, Nug Kayak heeb, ag Kayak oo niiṯe ele amu peheṯan doon, anamib g̱agaṯag daanna, danab kalulag ele daanna, ag dab mak aḏit ele iiṯa daaglagnu unuqidṯe.
Nug ag Kolosi daaṯeb amu Leodisia danab ah amu Hirapolis daaṯeb ele, ahilagnu ehanaṯak uḏat oḵainab heṯe amu, da amu doyeye madiḵulnu elele.
Lukas, ig lainignab, nug dokta, nug Dimas ele a ele ag humadṯep.
Amu ag dahil humiṯak ig lainḵad laa Leodesia daaṯeb ele amu ag maṯeg! Laa ele, ag dahil humiṯak Nimpas amu kristen tamaniak nug laugp̱a qag meṯeb ele, ag maṯeg!
Ag uḏug imu eb qewona amu mep̱eg uḵeb, Leodisia kristen tamaniak ele eb qeig! Aria uḏug Leodisia dilag yaami amu ag Kolosi daaṯeb amu ag amu ele eb qeig!
Aria ag Akipas amegp̱a, “Na uḏat Naḏi ep̱egp̱anu aome amu na uḏat amu hep̱e gogp̱a taḏ!” aon ap̱eg doyaḏ!
Da Paulus, da daḵa humaṯak nai ahilagnu iiḵu yaaṯem. Da mani guiṯakp̱a daaṯem amunu Kayak dahilnu unuqidḵulagnu aib daulag atiom. Kayaknu ehaniṯak oḵai Nug hamu megṯe ele amu ahilagp̱a dayaḏ!
